summary: Plan revision 22 and the registered design, architecture, verification, and operations documents are consistent and actionable for the bounded Electron bootstrap. Sidecar ownership, narrow preload API, failure states, restart-based recovery, accessibility requirements, and per-OS verification are clear. Bootstrap preview absence is distinguished from the future product preview requirement. The documents do not claim AC-01–18 or actual desktop verification complete. No material document-gate defect was found.

provenance.settings_attestation: Coordinator-reported dispatch settings; not independent runtime identity attestation.

method: Read solo-design-spec-review, current plan and contract, all registered design-spec artifacts, approved PRD, approval packet and receipt, relevant local research, and parent-plan linkage.
Compared journeys, permission and backend-to-UI state mappings, recovery semantics, destructive-action safeguards, desktop trust boundaries, acceptance scenarios, and evidence requirements.
Checked keyboard/focus, screen-reader announcements, contrast targets, 200% enlargement, responsive breakpoints, reduced motion, and target sizes against component contracts.
Verified all nine registered document hashes and the approval target/evidence hashes against local file bytes.
Inspected renderer source only to check bounded user-facing claims; no rendered-UI evidence was claimed.
limits: This document pass does not satisfy design_qa, desktop E2E, package lifecycle, accessibility runtime, or release gates.
The locked macOS GUI prevents current rendered-app inspection; Windows runtime evidence remains absent.
The bootstrap has no preview surface; future preview isolation requires a separate implementation and verification gate.
Restart-based recovery does not establish in-process reconnect, event-gap recovery, or duplicate-launch behavior.
Full-product persistence, provider integration, AC-01–18 completion, signing, public release, and auto-update remain outside this bootstrap pass.
